source_lineage.conversion_readme: Case Study Ω Simulation Triad Experiment README (v1.0)

modulation.description: Models manifold-level modulation across envelope-bound interaction surfaces using bounded structural channels.

gating.description: Applies manifold gating across primary, secondary, and envelope-contact surfaces.

alignment.description: Aligns structural flows across manifold surfaces without expressive geometry or curvature.

stabilization.description: Maintains stable manifold geometry during modulation cycles and envelope transitions.

dissipation.description: Models dissipation of manifold interaction intensity within bounded simulation envelopes.

residual_looping.description: Models residual looping behavior within manifold interaction basins formed by modulation and gating cycles.

non_activation_clause.description: This behavioral model is structural-only. It does not activate, simulate, or bind any NDH subsystem, expressive geometry mechanism, holonomy operator, or manifold process.
